title: Frankfurt Book Fair 2025
excerpt: A larger team, a full schedule of rights meetings and a networking hour at our stand that exceeded our expectations.
image_alt: Guests at the networking hour at our stand, Frankfurt Book Fair 2025
body: [Our second year with our own stand](/news/frankfurt-book-fair-2024/) at the Frankfurt Book Fair, held on 15–19 October 2025, saw us return with a larger team and something new to share beyond our books. On the fair’s second day, we hosted a networking hour at our stand, welcoming friends and colleagues from across the publishing world. Organising the gathering at short notice alongside a full schedule of rights meetings and presentations of our latest titles and bestsellers was an exciting challenge, and the turnout exceeded our expectations. It was a warm reminder that book fairs are also about the conversations between appointments: finally meeting the people we exchange emails with throughout the year, catching up over tea, coffee or a glass of wine, and getting to know one another beyond our lists. We left Frankfurt happy and proud, with stronger connections and the pleasure of having brought so many publishing friends together.
